title: Constant towers and evaluations preserve the unbounded derived adjunctions of a ringed morphism
statement:
Let $u:(\mathcal U,\mathcal O_{\mathcal U})\to(\mathcal V,\mathcal O_{\mathcal V})$ be a morphism of small ringed sites [def-weil-size-convention] whose coefficient map $u^{-1}\mathcal O_{\mathcal V}\to\mathcal O_{\mathcal U}$ is an isomorphism, so that module inverse image $u^*$ is exact. Use unbounded derived categories of module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] and the canonical derived adjunction $u^*\dashv Ru_*$, with $Ru_*$ computed on K-injective complexes [def-pur-kinjective-complex]. Put $J=\mathbf N_{\geq1}^{\mathrm{op}}$ and, for $W=\mathcal U,\mathcal V$, let $\mathcal T_W=\operatorname{Fun}(J,\operatorname{Mod}(\mathcal O_W))$ be the strict tower category [def-weil-inverse-system], realized as modules on the small diagram site [lem-weil-pbc-diagram-site-realization], with termwise inverse image $u^*_{\mathcal T}$, termwise direct image $u^{\mathcal T}_*$ and the canonical derived adjunction $u^*_{\mathcal T}\dashv\mathscr R_u$. Let $\Delta_W:\operatorname{Mod}(\mathcal O_W)\to\mathcal T_W$ be the constant-tower functor and $\operatorname{ev}_n:\mathcal T_W\to\operatorname{Mod}(\mathcal O_W)$ evaluation at $n\geq1$. Then:
(1) $\operatorname{ev}_1\dashv\Delta_W$, and the functors $\Delta_W$ and $\operatorname{ev}_n$ are exact and carry K-injective complexes to K-injective complexes.
(2) The termwise equalities $\Delta_{\mathcal U}u^*=u^*_{\mathcal T}\Delta_{\mathcal V}$ and $\operatorname{ev}_nu^*_{\mathcal T}=u^*\operatorname{ev}_n$ descend to the derived categories, and there are natural isomorphisms
$$b^\Delta:\Delta_{\mathcal V}Ru_*\xrightarrow{\sim}\mathscr R_u\Delta_{\mathcal U},\qquad b^n:\operatorname{ev}_n\mathscr R_u\xrightarrow{\sim}Ru_*\operatorname{ev}_n,$$
represented on a K-injective complex $I$ of $\mathcal O_{\mathcal U}$-modules by the identity of $\Delta_{\mathcal V}u_*I$, respectively on a K-injective complex $I$ of towers by the identity of $u_*I_n$.
(3) These comparisons carry derived adjuncts to derived adjuncts: for every derived morphism $t:u^*M\to N$ the derived adjunct of $\Delta_{\mathcal U}(t)$ is $b^\Delta_N\circ\Delta_{\mathcal V}(t^\sharp)$, and for every derived morphism $t:u^*_{\mathcal T}M\to N$ of towers the derived adjunct of $\operatorname{ev}_n(t)$ is $b^n_N\circ\operatorname{ev}_n(t^\sharp)$. In particular they identify the derived units and counits.
(4) Consequently, for a commutative square of such morphisms of small ringed sites whose inverse-image composition comparisons are computed termwise, $\Delta$ carries the ordinary derived square mate [def-weil-pbc-adjunction-mate] at $K$ to the termwise derived square mate at $\Delta K$, and $\operatorname{ev}_n$ carries the termwise derived square mate at a tower $K_\bullet$ to the ordinary one at $K_n$, after the isomorphisms of (2).
These are equalities of actual derived morphisms. No faithfulness of derived evaluation and no invertibility of either mate is asserted.
